description.html: The decorative skull is shaped like a human skull with deep eye sockets, prominent teeth and a network of dark cracks across the crown. The color is a warm pinkish beige, like bone that has lain in the ground for a long time, while the gray teeth and shadows in the hollows give it a realistic look. Next to stones and roots it easily becomes the centerpiece of a themed setup.

The skull is intended for both terrariums and aquariums. In a terrarium, small lizards, geckos and amphibians use it as a shelter while resting or when they are frightened. In an aquarium, fish explore the openings and the shade the skull creates, so it is a good choice for setups styled as sunken ruins.

Before placing the skull, rinse it with lukewarm water, without detergent. In a terrarium, set it on a firm base or bury it slightly so it cannot tip over onto an animal digging underneath. In an aquarium, place it on the bottom and check that fish can swim in and out of the openings freely, without the risk of getting stuck. Clean it with a soft brush and clean water.
